git checkout -b feat/extension-prompts-and-tools && git add -A && git commit -qm "feat: log when an extension replaces a tool, and test overrides

Tools with the same name as an earlier tool replace it, as pi's registerTool does. The log now says so. Tests cover wraps of tools and sections, their order, and replaced tools. The docs describe overrides." && git log --oneline -1
